commands:
set -e

REGION="ap-south-1"
REGISTRY="620503470929.dkr.ecr.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com"
IMAGE="$REGISTRY/8byte-devops-app:5"
DB_HOST="db-8byte-devops-postgres.c1ksmc4mixrx.ap-south-1.rds.amazonaws.com"
DB_PASSWORD="$(aws ssm get-parameter --name /8byte-devops/prod/db-password --with-decryption --query Parameter.Value --output text --region "$REGION")"

if [ -z "$DB_PASSWORD" ]; then
  echo "ERROR: Database password retrieval failed"
  exit 1
fi

aws ecr get-login-password --region "$REGION" | docker login --username AWS --password-stdin "$REGISTRY"

docker pull "$IMAGE"

echo "Initializing database..."
docker run --rm \
  -e DB_HOST="$DB_HOST" \
  -e DB_PORT="5432" \
  -e DB_NAME="taskdb" \
  -e DB_USER="appadmin" \
  -e DB_PASSWORD="$DB_PASSWORD" \
  "$IMAGE" python init_database.py

echo "Starting Flask application..."
docker rm -f task-manager >/dev/null 2>&1 || true

docker run -d \
  --name task-manager \
  --restart unless-stopped \
  -p 80:5000 \
  -e DB_HOST="$DB_HOST" \
  -e DB_PORT="5432" \
  -e DB_NAME="taskdb" \
  -e DB_USER="appadmin" \
  -e DB_PASSWORD="$DB_PASSWORD" \
  "$IMAGE"

unset DB_PASSWORD

echo "Deployment completed"
docker ps --filter name=task-manager
